label: Figure 3.2: The demand for concert tickets
alt: Two parallel downward-sloping demand curves for concert tickets, D and D1, with D1 to the right, and purple arrows showing the rightward shift.
caption: A rise in consumers’ incomes shifts the demand curve for concert tickets to the right, from D to D<sub>1</sub> (purple arrows). At the unchanged price p, quantity demanded rises from q to q<sub>1</sub>, and more is demanded at every price.
